name: popover
title: Popover
description: HBD popover: a click-triggered, non-modal (aria-modal="false", no backdrop/scroll-lock) floating panel built on Radix Popover, with the legacy .hbd-popover* BEM classes re-applied to the Radix parts so the de-shadowed popover.css renders 1:1. Compound Popover + Popover.Trigger (asChild) / Popover.Content / Popover.Close. Content renders the optional title header (with an icon-only ✕ Button), body (children), optional footer prop, and a CSS-triangle arrow that tracks the resolved data-side after collision flip. placement (top/bottom default/left/right) + offset flow via context (default 8). Escape + outside-pointerdown dismissal, focus trap + focus return, and aria-haspopup/expanded/controls wiring all come from Radix. Controlled-first: open + onOpenChange + defaultOpen, plus onOpen/onClose bridging the WC's hbd:open/hbd:close events.
